name: breadboard
description: Build, run and learn breadboard circuits in the browser, project by project from video courses.

paragraphs: An interactive browser simulator that follows Ben Eater's YouTube playlist Building an 8-bit breadboard computer! video by video.

the series. It has 16 bytes of RAM, A/B registers, an adder/subtractor ALU with carry and zero flags, a microcoded control unit and a decimal display. You can pulse the clock by hand or let it run, and watch every control signal and bus transfer. It also has an assembler with Ben's programs, a live microcode table you can edit, and a microcode-version picker that matches the stage of the series.

has 49 chips with his reference designators, 88 LEDs, the decimal display and every wire. The running simulation lights the LEDs, and the clock button, mode switches, DIP switches and reset work on the boards themselves. The boards are also real circuits: composed together and simulated chip by chip, they run Ben's 28 + 14 program and latch 42 (see tests/boards-output-control.test.ts).
